## Problem and change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and any configuration or compatibility impact. Link the issue when applicable.

## Validation

Describe meaningful regression coverage and check results. Note checks you could not run; distinguish local mocks from any deliberately invoked provider or model checks.

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run test:package`
- [ ] Relevant help and documentation are updated, or no update is needed.
- [ ] Changes and attachments contain no credentials, private prompts, transcripts or session logs.

For routing changes, explain effects on model compatibility, task continuity and Claude-owned authentication/permission decisions. For telemetry changes, explain privacy and schema compatibility. Remove this paragraph if neither applies.
